messages:
Ava Liu (CSM): Heads-up 00: NovaVista's usage fell from ~120k tokens/day to ~4k since their ML lead left last week. Renewal in ~8 weeks. Their PM told me they're validating a competitor demo and an internal embed pipeline.
Liam O'Connor (AE): thanks Ava. any sign of billing/contract churn? procurement reached out?
Ava Liu (CSM): Procurement opened a doc request but no RFP yet. They asked for SSO + revised SOC attestation wording. PM's note: 'shortlisting a managed vendor and an infra partner for embeddings.'
Elena Park (Solutions): Two quick asks: 1) can we surface per-model latency/cost delta for their most-used endpoint (semantic-search-embed) so AE can justify cost vs perf? 2) prepare a short competitor comparison (indexing speed, 99p latency, per-embed cost). I can draft the tech side.
Marcus Diaz (Support): Edge logs show normal traffic to /v1/embeddings until 2024-06-18 16:22 UTC then traffic drops ~96% to a few internal test calls. Error rates are low. Looks intentional.
Ava Liu (CSM): PM said "we paused production while we validate quality and cost." That's the risky phrase. Could mean they're running side-by-side eval.
Liam O'Connor (AE): Ok classify as high-touch renewal risk. Offer: 30-day free Dedicated trial for their embedding pipeline + migration concierge (one architecture sync). Worth offering as a retention gesture?
Elena Park (Solutions): Yes, and include Redwood Optimize suggestions: quantized model variant for embeddings (int8) and batch sizing set to 64 for their workload. Should cut per-embed cost ~3x in our bench. I'll attach micro-bench numbers on call.
redwood-bot: Reminder create renewal-watch RW-2024-332 and tag account novavista.
Ava Liu (CSM): RW-2024-332 created. Scheduling a 30-min "health + pilot" sync Wed 09:30 PT. Invite to PM, procurement, infra, and AE.
Marcus Diaz (Support): Also found a short note in their internal changelog: "experiment: switch to local Faiss + Lambda runner for embeddings" dated 06/18. Could be a temporary PoC.
Liam O'Connor (AE): Action items: 1) I'll ask procurement for the shortlist + timeline 2) Ava, lead the pilot offer and ask for their success criteria (latency, p99, recall @K). 3) Elena, prepare a 1-slide perf/cost summary and a migration checklist.
Elena Park (Solutions): Draft slide: current Redwood call path -> 110ms median, 220ms p99, cost $0.0009/embed. Competitor demo reported 85ms median but unverified cost. Our Optimize path (int8 + batch64) -> 70ms median, 160ms p99, est $0.0003/embed. Will include test commands and eval harness.
Ava Liu (CSM): On call ask: are they running any synthetic evals vs their golden dataset? If yes, request the dataset or a sample prompt set so we can run apples-to-apples. Offer to run our eval in Redwood Console and share results.
Marcus Diaz (Support): I'll export recent traces and a sample trace showing production payload shape (good to show no extra headers needed).
redwood-bot: Note escalate to AM lead if procurement asks for concessions > 25% discount.
Liam O'Connor (AE): Good call. If they sign up to the Dedicated trial we should also lock a short SLA for the trial window. I'll prep a trial agreement template.
Ava Liu (CSM): Agreement in motion. If they confirm a competitor PoC, we escalate immediately and ask for a joint tech validation session within 48h. For now, treat as renewal-risk watch.
Elena Park (Solutions): Also preparing a quick playbook: 1) run Console eval job 2) compare recall@10/50 3) present optimized config 4) offer migration concierge. Link to example commands in the invite.
Ava Liu (CSM): Thanks team. Next check-in after Wed 09:30 PT sync. Keeping RW-2024-332 open. :eyes:
